scope.method: Actually displayed and visually inspected all 42 specified qa_visual/page_NNN.png images with tools.view_image; this is a sampled visual review, not a claim of visually reviewing all 272 PDF pages.
coverage: Contents pages 4–10: Chapters 1–13, Appendices A–F, long wrapped entries, and the separate right-aligned page-number column.
All eight unique English charts on pages 17, 20, 21, 23, 26, 27, 44, and 184; the repeated TSMC chart on page 180 was also inspected.
Long tables and formulas on pages 96–97, 126–129, and 131–132; sampled chapter and appendix openings; headers, footers, font/glyph rendering, wrapping, and page boundaries.
scope.result: No material overlap, cropping, missing glyphs, unreadable body text, or inappropriate word splitting observed in the inspected pages. Table headers repeat cleanly across pages 128–129, and long titles and page-number columns remain distinct.
scope.limits: Visual layout review only. This review did not re-research factual claims, audit translation fidelity, recalculate financial assumptions, or independently exercise PDF link destinations. Pages 1, 2, 3, 254, and 272 were outside this reviewer's assigned 42-page sample.
scope.identity_check: Recomputed the actual PDF SHA-256 and confirmed equality with manifest.json outputs.pdf.sha256 and qa.json pdf_sha256.

prior_findings_resolution.resolution: Not reproduced. manifest.json contains the nested field outputs.pdf.sha256; it is not a separate file named outputs.pdf.sha256. Its value matches the actual PDF and qa.json.

prior_findings_resolution.finding: Pages 128–129: Chinese business- / systems team header wrapping
prior_findings_resolution.resolution: Normal wrapping at the existing hyphen in business-systems. The complete two-line header stays within its cell, remains legible, and repeats consistently on the next page. It does not impair interpretation and is not a material readability or layout defect.
